body:
Hi Jason,

I've followed your architectural posts regarding distributed transactional consistency and your recent Astro edge deployments. We are currently architecting a real-time analytics telemetry product and are hitting architectural divergence across the engineering leadership.

Outline of inquiry scope: We are scaling our time-series ingestion pipeline to 500k TPS and need guidance on PostgreSQL 16 partitioning with hypertable abstractions versus migrating cold/warm slices directly to ClickHouse. Concurrently, we are scoping a zero-layout-shift telemetry dashboard built on Astro SSR and WebSockets for low-latency dispatching.

We would like to retain you for a 6-week fractional advisory sprint beginning mid-November to review our schema migrations, evaluate query bottlenecks, and author the RFC for client-side state sync.

-- Jane Doe, Lead Systems Architect & Co-Founder

Hi Jason,

Our investment committee is conducting due diligence on a Series B telemetry and observability infrastructure startup. We require an independent evaluation of their multi-tenant streaming architecture, Citus shard allocation strategy, and edge latency benchmarks.

Looking for a 10-day technical audit sprint starting next Monday.
